chunks: Shake the trunk of the date-palm tree towards you, it will drop upon you ripe dates easily gathered.

key_terms.جِذْعِ: Trunk or stem of a tree
key_terms.رُطَبًا: Fresh, ripe dates (still on the tree or recently fallen)

ai.seo_question: What miracle did Mary (Maryam) experience during childbirth according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (19:25) is often linked to the subsequent command to drink from a stream (19:26), symbolizing the transition from physical sustenance to spiritual clarity and the purification of Maryam’s lineage. The miracle underscores the concept of *karāmah* (divine grace) for the righteous, illustrating how God provides ease (*yusr*) amidst the distress of childbirth, a theme frequently cited in sermons regarding the Ahl al-Bayt. This event is viewed not merely as a physical provision but as a divine preparation for the birth of Isa (Jesus), emphasizing purity and divine support in moments of isolation.
